findings.title: Images are heavier than they need to be
findings.root_cause: Large, oversized or legacy-format image files delay the largest paint and cost mobile visitors data, so visitors arriving from search or an AI answer wait longer

evidence.description: https://www.propublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/D5612E06-F25D-4891-8753-A68B9ABB663C_d64c8e.jpg: the file is 479 KB (likely the largest image on the page)
https://www.propublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/20260507-Sanchez-Family-Homelessness-106.jpg?w=2560: the file is 303 KB (likely the largest image on the page)

findings.evidence_text: https://www.propublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/D5612E06-F25D-4891-8753-A68B9ABB663C_d64c8e.jpg: the file is 479 KB (likely the largest image on the page); https://www.propublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/20260507-Sanchez-Family-Homelessness-106.jpg?w=2560: the file is 303 KB (likely the largest image on the page)

suggested_action.summary: Compress, resize and convert the listed images
steps: Serve AVIF or WebP, with JPEG or PNG only as a fallback in <picture>
Resize each image to the largest size it is displayed at and add srcset and sizes for smaller screens
Compress photos, aiming for under 200 KB for the largest image of a page
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Faster largest paint and less data for visitors on mobile
suggested_action.verification: Re-run the audit and confirm the listed images are smaller
suggested_action.implementation_detail: Serve AVIF or WebP, resize each image to its displayed size with srcset, and compress large photos.
suggested_action.expected_outcome: Images load faster, especially the largest image of each page.
suggested_action.quadrant_label: Deprioritize: more work than the value it brings for now

findings.mechanism: Large, oversized or legacy-format image files delay the largest paint and cost mobile visitors data.
findings.implementation_detail: Serve AVIF or WebP, resize each image to its displayed size with srcset, and compress large photos.
findings.expected_outcome: Images load faster, especially the largest image of each page.

limitations: 157 discovered URL(s) were never fetched (permission, acquisition failure, or budget constraints; out of 163 discovered); findings reflect only the 6 page(s) actually crawled, not the whole site. The sample reached 2 of 37 site sections (first path segment).

Headless browser rendering was not available in this environment; rendering-gap findings are based on a static-content heuristic only and are reported as suspected/insufficient_evidence rather than confirmed.
No external search provider was configured; claim corroboration and off-site footprint assessment were not checked this run (not the same as "nothing found").

No search for same-named knowledge-graph entities was run: robots.txt for Wikidata and Wikipedia disallows their search endpoints, so only the agent stage (AG-05) can look the brand name up; namesake ambiguity is unassessed.
Linked sameAs and review profiles were not fetched (OFF_SITE_LOOKUP=0), so whether they resolve and belong to the brand was not checked.

Review and directory platforms (Trustpilot, G2, Google Business Profile and others) were not searched for the brand: they block automated clients, no search provider was configured, and the agent stage (AG-06) was not supplied. Only profiles linked from the site were considered.
Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) were not measured: the audit runs no browser and no PAGESPEED_API_KEY is configured. Web-vitals findings are estimates from markup patterns, not measurements.
Colour contrast and tap-target size were judged only where inline styles set them; colours and sizes from stylesheets need a browser to compute and were not assessed.
32 same-origin content image(s) were not measured for file size (per-audit cap of 4 or remaining budget); cross-origin images are never requested, so their weight is unassessed.

confidence.method: min(sample_representativeness, observation_completeness, execution_penalty), where sample_representativeness = max(crawl_completeness, min(section_coverage, sample_size)), capped at 0.9 unless discovery_reliable is true, and crawl_completeness = pages_analyzed / pages_discovered; observation_completeness = (pages read in full + half of pages read in part) / (pages analyzed + challenged, waiting-room, timed-out and failed fetches). A weak link caps the score rather than being averaged out. identity_confidence is reported beside the score, not in it: it gates only the checks that depend on the brand's identity
confidence.interpretation: A heuristic rating of how far the report speaks for the whole site, not a calibrated probability. Each finding states its own confidence.

reasons.sample_representativeness: The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 6 of 163 discovered page(s) and reached 2 of 37 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched).
reasons.observation_completeness: Every page the audit tried to read was read in full.
reasons.identity_confidence: The brand identity is clear: the Organization markup names one brand.

confidence.explanation: Confidence is low (0.05). The weakest of its parts sets the score, here the page sample. The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 6 of 163 discovered page(s) and reached 2 of 37 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched). Brand identity (reported separately, not part of the score): The brand identity is clear: the Organization markup names one brand. The score rates how far the report speaks for the whole site; each finding has its own confidence and status, and a problem seen on a page is still real on that page.

whats_working.title: robots.txt allows crawling
whats_working.evidence: robots.txt was read and lets crawlers fetch the start URL.

whats_working.title: AI and search crawlers may fetch the site
whats_working.evidence: robots.txt lets all 18 AI and search crawlers checked fetch the site, and closes no discovered site section to them (AI search: OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Applebot; user-requested fetch: ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, Meta-ExternalFetcher, MistralAI-User; model training: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot, Bytespider).

whats_working.title: An XML sitemap is available
whats_working.evidence: An XML sitemap was read; it lists at least 9 URLs.

whats_working.title: Pages are served over HTTPS
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked were served over HTTPS.

whats_working.title: Fetched pages load without HTTP errors
whats_working.evidence: None of the 6 pages fetched answered with an HTTP error (4xx or 5xx).

whats_working.title: Every page has a title
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked have a document title.

whats_working.title: Every page has a meta description
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked have a meta description.

whats_working.title: Every page declares its language
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked declare their language (html lang).

whats_working.title: Pages are open to indexing and snippets
whats_working.evidence: None of the 6 pages checked carries a noindex, nosnippet or max-snippet:0 directive (meta robots or X-Robots-Tag).

whats_working.title: Structured data parses cleanly
whats_working.evidence: JSON-LD structured data is on 6 of the 6 pages checked, and every block parsed.

whats_working.title: Content is in the raw HTML
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked carry their text in the raw HTML, so crawlers that do not run JavaScript can read it.

whats_working.title: Mobile viewport is declared and zoom is allowed
whats_working.evidence: All 6 pages checked declare a mobile viewport, and none blocks zooming.

whats_working.title: Images carry alt attributes
whats_working.evidence: All 165 images on the pages checked carry an alt attribute, and none was flagged as a file name or placeholder.

whats_working.title: Every page links onward
whats_working.evidence: Each of the 6 pages crawled links to at least one other page on the site.
